classificationNotes: Source-draft Slimes are treated as an amorphous visual and encounter-production family, not as accepted claims about biology, cognition, feeding, agency, personhood, or universal hostility. Engulfing and digestion are encounter proposals; the packet preserves gravity-led jelly, visible contents, and a core weak point while humanoid structure begins only at T3.
visualConstants: Rounded, drooping, gravity-obeying jelly with surface-tension edges and a readable internal core remains the family silhouette.
Translucent blue, acid green, amber, or violet is chosen per individual, with suspended debris and a brighter but bounded core.
Viscous flow, drip trails, swallowed objects, crystalline cores, and later crust plates remain spatially coherent.
Internal structure emerges by tier: pseudopod, debris-bearing blob, humanoid crust frame, suspended skeleton, then a multicore tide.
escalationAxis: Internal structure and battlefield coordination emerge from formlessness, culminating in a multicore sovereign that redistributes its own mass through lesser slimes.

constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity translucent colors and core glow remain ordinary slime optics and cognition markers; neither implies Water nor a generic magical affinity.
Jelly flow, surface sheen, suspended debris, crystalline core, crust, and drip wake remain physical and restrained without elemental substitutions.
normal.counterplaySignal: The established core, debris gap, crust joint, skeleton brace, or active T5 core remains visible through native jelly.
forbidden: Treating translucent color or core light as an affinity

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and carry ember grit around the existing core; T3–T4 preserve their source-supported humanoid crust frame; T5 alone retains its dozen cores across a heat-baffled tide.
Fuel-bearing char crust, smoke vents, pulsing ember seams, and boiled-clear jelly create directional combustion cycles without replacing the viscous body.
fire.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and vent around one core; T3–T4 expose a humanoid crust joint after combustion; T5 exposes one of its dozen cores when heat baffles cycle.

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and suspend grit around the existing core; T3–T4 preserve their source-supported humanoid crust frame; T5 alone retains its dozen cores within sediment cells.
Layered mineral inclusions, load-bearing crust ribs, compressed foot pools, localized dust, and pale fracture seams make mass and faults legible.
earth.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and expose one grit-ringed core; T3–T4 expose a humanoid crust joint after a planted push; T5 exposes one of its dozen cores when a sediment cell fractures.

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and streamline around the existing core; T3–T4 preserve their source-supported humanoid crust frame; T5 alone retains its dozen cores in separated pressure lobes.
Directional membrane ridges, debris streamers, vapor channels, flattened leading edges, and a still pocket behind the core show coherent pressure flow.
wind.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and reveal one still core; T3–T4 expose a humanoid crust joint when flow reverses; T5 exposes one of its dozen cores when a pressure lobe collapses.

constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and route pressure around the existing core; T3–T4 preserve their source-supported humanoid crust frame; T5 alone retains its dozen cores in valved chambers.
Coherent clear-water channels, wet reflection, misted pressure vents, membrane valves, and visible drainage distinguish engineered Water affinity from native jelly.
water.counterplaySignal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and expose one core after pressure loss; T3–T4 expose a humanoid crust joint when a valve drains; T5 exposes one of its dozen cores as each chamber empties.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Probe footwork with one tiny core-led hop and a short corrosive puddle.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the dark core chooses the landing point before the jelly follows.
forms.signatureMechanic: Core Hop: the dark dot shifts to one side and the single pseudopod springs toward that line.
forms.telegraph: The clear mass stretches behind the displaced dark core.
forms.counterplay: Leave the core line and strike the overextended dot before the body recoils.
forms.visualDelta: Fist-sized, almost clear droplet with one dark core dot and one wobbling pseudopod; no humanoid structure.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Repeat lane pressure by rolling swallowed debris toward its leading edge.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach players to read internal contents as the next impact side.
forms.signatureMechanic: Debris Roll: coins and bones gather ahead of the core before the knee-high mass surges.
forms.telegraph: Cloudy jelly clears along one edge while coins and bones tumble toward it.
forms.counterplay: Cross behind the debris line and hit the core through the newly clear rear wall.
forms.visualDelta: Knee-high cloudy blob with coins, small bones, a slow drip trail, and no humanoid structure.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Its wake gives Droplets a faster Core Hop, but crossing behind the Blob denies both lanes.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a stance controller that moves its first humanoid crust between guard and thrust shapes.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that hardened shoulders protect only the side facing the crystalline chest core.
forms.signatureMechanic: Crust Stance: shoulder crust flows into one arm-like brace, guarding a lane while leaving the opposite core edge clear.
forms.telegraph: The glowing chest core slides under one shoulder and the crust audibly crystallizes there.
forms.counterplay: Circle to the unarmored side and strike the exposed core edge before the brace liquefies and transfers.
forms.visualDelta: First roughly humanoid jelly outline, glowing crystalline chest core, and hardened shoulder crust arranged like armor.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Blob debris can reinforce the chosen brace; clearing the Blob keeps the exposed side soft.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Control space by posing its suspended skeleton as a brace, cage, or striking frame.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that each armor plate follows a visible bone and collapses when that bone is displaced.
forms.signatureMechanic: Borrowed Frame: the full skeleton locks into one of three poses and absorbed armor plates float onto its load-bearing bones.
forms.telegraph: Bones rotate into alignment and matching armor plates click toward them through the jelly.
forms.counterplay: Break the unplated pivot bone during commitment to collapse the pose and expose the core.
forms.visualDelta: Towering humanoid mass with a full posed skeleton and absorbed armor plates suspended in place.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: It absorbs Blob debris to repair one plate; interrupting the debris roll prevents the repair.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Transform the arena into three moving tide basins while delegating distinct core patterns to lesser slimes.
forms.teachingGoal: Test core reads, debris direction, crust stance, and skeletal pivots as the sovereign redistributes mass.
forms.signatureMechanic: Arena Transformation — Twelve-Core Tide: four cores enter each basin and command Droplet hops, Blob rolls, or Ooze Knight crust walls; clearing the announced pattern exposes that basin's lead core and permanently lowers its tide.
forms.telegraph: Absorbed weapons form a face toward one basin while four of the dozen cores align beneath it and its tide rises.
forms.counterplay: Answer the called lower-form pattern, then strike the aligned lead core; each broken lead core drains one basin and removes that command set.
forms.visualDelta: Near-liquid titan with a dozen cores, absorbed weapons and armor suggesting a face, and a tide of lesser slimes at its base.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Droplets, Blobs, and Ooze Knights carry one basin's learned rule; defeating them opens their aligned lead core instead of merely adding bodies.
